authority: Original PR #1 alpha/terminal-wealth-first continuation. The user authorizes a structurally new opportunity-discovery engine while preserving causal next-session execution, frozen data, costs and execution constraints.

current_alpha_leader.finding: Sparse campaign-specific displacement substantially improves full-history wealth across all three core scopes, but the 2023-2025 union screen remains below control.

quality_admission_rejection.finding: Cross-sectional trend-quality admission plus absolute-score ownership still regresses union and changes campaign composition enough to create 51/53 broad-scope displacements.

explosive_accelerator_boundary.finding: Prior top-decile/new-high/volume/capacity expansion was already rejected, including union 4.744148x to 1.549907x. The new family therefore does not use volume confirmation, decile selection, extra slots or idle-cash acceleration.

economic_hypothesis: High exposure needs an alpha score whose numeric meaning is comparable across time, not a session percentile. A causal absolute leadership strength built from multi-scale excess trend magnitude, directional efficiency, persistence and follow-through should reject choppy broad-pool entries while allowing the same campaign score to decay coherently over time.

treatment.ownership_base: Reuse offensive_alpha_decay_displacement unchanged except that its admission ranking, frozen campaign reference, incumbent decay and challenger comparison all consume absolute_leadership_strength instead of techquant.features.score.

absolute_leadership_strength.short_progress: At close D use log(close_D / close_{D-Config.fast}) with Config.fast=10; require it to be positive.
absolute_leadership_strength.slow_excess: At close D use 40-session log progress minus the current-session median 40-session log progress among causally ready names. This remains in log-return units rather than a percentile; require the excess to be positive.
absolute_leadership_strength.multi_scale_core: sqrt(short_progress * slow_excess). Both inputs must be positive, so no signed or fitted weighting is introduced.
absolute_leadership_strength.directional_efficiency: Positive 40-session log progress divided by the sum of absolute one-session log moves over the same 40-session path, using only closes through D.
absolute_leadership_strength.persistence: Fraction of the latest Config.fast=10 sessions, including D, whose close is above the existing causal EMA20.
absolute_leadership_strength.follow_through: Current close divided by the highest close in the preceding Config.slow=40 sessions excluding D. This is a continuous causal factor, not a breakout threshold.
absolute_leadership_strength.formula: multi_scale_core * directional_efficiency * persistence * follow_through. Invalid/not-ready/nonpositive short_progress or slow_excess produces no positive leadership strength. No coefficients are learned or searched.

treatment.eligibility: Keep the offensive alpha-decay price/trend admission gate: fresh/ready quote, observed_trend entry, close above EMA20, positive 5-session momentum, broad market admission open, no security break, not held and not retired. Replace the old score-positive/ranking input only with finite positive absolute_leadership_strength.
treatment.campaign_reference: Freeze the chosen symbol's absolute_leadership_strength at the close that requests a vacancy fill and bind it only after actual inventory is observed.
treatment.displacement: With a full intact book, an incumbent becomes displacement-eligible only after current absolute_leadership_strength falls below its own frozen admission strength and the strongest currently eligible challenger has strength strictly above that frozen incumbent reference. Reuse one-way retirement, blocked-sale retry and no-same-close-sale-proceeds semantics unchanged.
treatment.capacity_and_execution: Exactly two positions as in the preregistered campaign owner. No accelerator capacity, no volume rule, no leverage/shorting. Preserve observed-cash funding, close decision / next-session execution, sells before buys, prior-volume liquidity, board lots, T+1, fees, slippage and price limits.

structural_difference_from_prior_work: Unlike offensive_trend_quality and offensive_quality_admission, no cross-sectional percentile is ever frozen or compared across time; the score remains in an absolute trend-strength scale.
Unlike explosive_campaign_accelerator, there is no top-decile rule, volume confirmation, sector-peer trigger, extra capacity or idle-cash sleeve.
Unlike the old ranking learner, no model, future label, fitted coefficient or expanding-window training exists.
Unlike neighboring EMA/lookback searches, only existing Config.fast=10, Config.slow=40 and the existing EMA20 are used; this contract freezes one formula and permits no horizon/weight grid.

measurement.primary_objective: maximize mean(log(terminal wealth)) across the three fixed scopes
measurement.secondary_objective: maximize minimum terminal wealth across the three fixed scopes
measurement.promotion_rule: Advance only if mean-log wealth and minimum wealth improve, at least one broad scope improves, and joint optical-leader removal remains above 1.0. Later formal promotion still requires an economically material improvement, not 1-2% noise.
measurement.failure_rule: If rejected, preserve the complete result and move to a substantively different alpha structure. Do not tune component weights, horizons, excess cutoffs, displacement margins, capacity or position count.
